calculation.description: Contrarian signal: invert 60-session momentum scaled by average downside magnitude, with a modest 10-session recovery confirmation multiplier. The persisted direction is negative because the raw downside-adjusted momentum had negative forward IC. All rolling inputs are shifted one session before evaluation.

validation.regime_notes: Inverted signal was strongly positive in aggregate; raw signal 60D IC was -0.203514. Regime IC for the inverted signal: 2024-2026 not separately available in this run; 2027-2029 +0.164822, 2030 +0.305753, 2031-2032 +0.207633, 2033 YTD -0.095008. Small 15-instrument cross-section, so date-level breadth and long history are emphasized; recent drift requires conservative weighting.
